title: DataMate inference contract v0 per-question result
description: Machine-readable contract for one offline DataMate question. The root schema validates the internal result record. Request, plan, answer, tool and submission schemas live in $defs and are exposed via x-schemas. Examples in x-examples use synthetic values only.
x-normative-notes: Answer type and execution status are independent fields; abstain is not a competition answer type.
execution_error, source_missing, blocked_on_catalog, budget_exhausted and insufficient_evidence are distinct reason codes.
A valid empty result is not numeric zero; null aggregates are insufficient evidence.
A fully out-of-coverage period and a proven missing source role are unanswerable, not abstain.
Only verified catalog tables and columns may be referenced by tools or SQL.
Gold answers, answer references, public-test labels and evaluation scores are forbidden in inference payloads.
All budgets are candidate values pending lead and evaluation approval.

x-retrieval-policy.rationale: Per-business schemas are small and the verified catalog is the source of truth; no embedding corpus or embedding budget is established for v0.
retrieval_units: verified table, column, grain and key metadata
normalisation: retain the original data value for string/list answers

max_input_tokens.rationale: bounded grounded context; confirm with model tokenizer and quality comparison

max_tool_calls.rationale: schema + entity + sample + SQL + one repair round

max_retrieval_rounds.rationale: initial context plus one targeted evidence request

max_sql_attempts.rationale: initial SQL plus two corrective retries (two retries, not two total attempts)

max_sample_rows.rationale: enough to inspect formats without leaking a dataset

question_timeout_ms.rationale: end-to-end question guard under offline evaluation

x-tool-contracts.name: get_schema
x-tool-contracts.purpose: Return verified table and column metadata for the current business.

x-tool-contracts.name: search_entities
x-tool-contracts.purpose: Resolve product/customer/supplier mentions against catalog aliases and distinct values.

x-tool-contracts.name: sample_rows
x-tool-contracts.purpose: Show a deterministic, tiny sample of a verified table for value/format inspection.

x-tool-contracts.name: run_sql
x-tool-contracts.purpose: Plan and execute exactly one read-only SELECT over verified tables.

ok.note: Concrete typed answer backed by verified evidence.

invalid_request.note: Request failed validation; no safe answer.

invalid_model_output.note: Model output was unparseable or ungrounded.

ambiguous_entity.note: Entity match remains ambiguous after retrieval.

blocked_on_catalog.note: Verified catalog is unavailable or incomplete.

source_missing.note: An expected runtime source file/table is absent.

unsupported_source_role.note: The required source role is proven absent from the business package.

period_out_of_coverage.note: The whole requested period is outside measured data coverage.

subjective_information.note: The data cannot record the requested subjective fact.

insufficient_evidence.note: Result was empty, null or unverifiable.

timeout.note: Question or query deadline was exceeded.

schema_mismatch.note: Runtime schema disagrees with the verified catalog.

verification_failed.note: Evidence, grain, unit or answer-shape check failed.

x-open-decisions.question: Which offline GGUF model and runtime meet quality, latency and memory limits?
Does dense retrieval beat schema-aware lexical retrieval on development traces?
Are the candidate token, tool, retry, row and timeout limits approved?
Does the evaluator accept the optional alias field for every answer type?
Are product normalisation keys materialised or implemented as DataFusion functions?
Should the project pin DataFusion 55.0.0 instead of the current >=43 range?
Which candidate biz_105 name joins have measured uniqueness and coverage?
How should the 2,222 duplicate-excess sales rows be handled per rulebook §8?
